name: Chester County Preservation Partnership Program: Conservancy Grants
summary: Matching grants from Chester County for nonprofit land conservation organisations to buy land or easements for natural area preservation and to improve public access. The same programme also funds municipalities and farmland easements.

steps: Mandatory pre-application meeting or site visit

eligibility.rule: Have conservation and preservation of open space as a primary purpose
For improvement grants, also has stewardship of open space as a primary purpose
Be tax-exempt under Internal Revenue Code Section 501(c)(3)
Be registered with Pennsylvania's Bureau of Charitable Organizations
For acquisition grants, pre-qualified by DCNR to receive Land Trust acquisition grants
Have existed for at least 5 consecutive years
For improvements, hold a legal interest in the land, except qualifying farmland projects
For trail projects, keep the site publicly open and designated for public use

documents: Signed and attested grant contract signature page
Executed nonprofit board resolution accepting the grant terms
Landowner Letter of Understanding, for acquisition projects
Draft easement language or easement restrictions summary, for conservation easement projects
Proposed acquisition project location and public access map
Letters of funding commitment from all contributing sources
Donor commitments for goods or services counted toward matching funds

status.quote: Applications must be received by 4 p.m. on April 30, 2026.

deadline.quote: Applications must be received by 4 p.m. on April 30, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: grants to municipalities and nonprofit land conservation organizations to permanently preserve natural, recreational, and agricultural open space resources

geography.quote: The Commissioners of Chester County, Pennsylvania offer the Preservation Partnership Program

access.quote: How to Apply: Submit digital files to: Monica Mullaji at mmullaji@chesco.org

window.quote: Round 38 of the Preservation Partnership Program anticipates the award of approximately $2 million in open space funds.

co_finance_required.quote: Public Benefit Improvement Grants fund up to 50% of eligible costs with a $50,000 maximum for the construction of publicly accessible trails and trail-related amenities, and for nature-based improvements on permanently preserved land that will benefit water quality or contribute to habitat restoration.

effort.quote: Contact Monica Mullaji, Preservation Programs Coordinator at 484-883-7103 or mmullaji@chesco.org as early as possible in the project development process to schedule the mandatory project meeting or site visit.
Submit the grant application package to the Department of Parks + Preservation by 4:00 p.m. on April 30, 2026.
Application review will begin upon receipt of a complete application, based on the Project Evaluation Criteria shown in Section IV of this document.

eligibility.quote: have a primary purpose of conservation and preservation of open space, parklands, or natural areas for public benefit;
have a primary purpose of conservation, preservation, and stewardship of open space, parklands, or natural areas for public benefit;
are tax-exempt under Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986;
are registered with the Bureau of Charitable Organizations within the Pennsylvania Department of State;
are pre-qualified by the Pennsylvania Department of Conservation and Natural Resources (DCNR) as eligible to receive Land Trust acquisition grants;
have been in existence for at least 5 consecutive years.

own or have a legal interest in the land on which the improvements will be made (except for projects on land preserved through the County Agricultural Land Preservation Program as described below in 2.F).

The site must be open to the public at regularly scheduled and posted days and times and the land upon which the trail and any accessory structures are proposed must be permanently designated for public use prior to the release of any County funds.

co_finance.quote: Landowner donation of value is an eligible source of matching funds.

documents.quote: 5. Landowner Letter of Understanding Supporting Documentation to Include: 6. Signed and attested grant contract signature page
Executed resolution from the Board of the nonprofit agreeing to apply for the grant and to accept the terms of the grant contract and the Preservation Partnership Program
For conservation easement projects, draft easement language or summary of easement restrictions 12. Current photographs of the site
Map(s) showing proposed project location, size of parcel(s), public access, the land use and protection status of adjacent parcels, and any other pertinent information
Letters of funding commitment from all sources contributing to the project
Copy of a letter to the municipality in which the project is located, notifying them about the project and giving them an opportunity to comment on it
